beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Buddy now installs just for you on Windows, so updates stop asking for permission. If an older copy is still installed for everyone on this computer, Buddy offers Remove it or Not now. Once it is removed, other teachers on that computer install Buddy for themselves.
• Checking, downloading and preparing an update all happen in the update window. Downloads have a real Cancel, and an update you put off comes back through the banner.
• The grading page's bottom band is one paper surface. Page tools sit on their own tab, and a thumbnail's grip shows only while the pointer is over it.
• The grade comment sits in the grading row and grows as you type, then folds when you click away. On the Chat tab it waits as a dashed bubble until you choose Post to thread or Keep with the grade.
• Task has its own tab between Chat and Rubric, and Chat runs the full height of the panel with the reply box at the bottom.
• The demo tour brings each step's screen forward and hands you a worksheet to drag on the drop step. Its slides always play.
• Automatic pre-grading now skips only work already graded in Schoology, and pre-grades everything else in any learning period. Turn it on or off from the To-do menu.
• A pre-grade with any model output shows it with a banner instead of stopping. One that does stop says why and what to do next.
• Reading & AI: click anywhere on a None, OCR only or OCR + AI card. Auto-configure says what this computer can run and suggests a model that fits.
• Grade and Choose work the same way across learning periods, and a student's row unfolds out of its header as one motion. Work not yet graded opens in Grade, and a missing upload offers Check upload.
• The Appearance, PDF output and Schoology settings pages are tidier, with matching controls and aligned rows.
• The welcome wizard's folder step shows the records it found as one clear card, and the setup screens share one look.

Fixes:
• Up and down arrows on number boxes respond when clicked.
• The window no longer freezes briefly at a session's first message, and report card progress stays smooth while a job runs.
• Long student names in To-do shorten with an ellipsis instead of being cut off.
• Checking an update's signature no longer flashes a console window.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Drag a file into Compare or Verify to reveal the thumbnails. Drop it before, between or after pages to add it there. When you drop a file on a course tile that already has a sample, you can add its pages or replace the sample.
• Each paper opens at Page Width, so the page fills the viewer from side to side. If you choose another zoom, the next papers open at your zoom.
• The Found for you card has Next pin. Each press zooms to the next name, date or grade pin on the paper and says which one it is (for example "Date, 2 of 3"). P steps through them too, and Hide pins hides them.
• After you test a connection, Reading & AI says where it connected and what it found, for example "Connected to this computer: 3 models, including gemma4:e4b." If you type this computer's own address under another computer, it says so.
• On a laptop, the gemma4:26b download (about 16 GB) is now beside the model in Reading & AI.
• If the model you grade with goes missing, Buddy now asks only when you have chosen AI grading. It says which model it was looking for, and offers a model that is installed, Open AI settings, or Not now. Not now holds until your AI settings change.

Fixes:
• Keeping your records when you change your work folder now copies everything they point to, including your edited papers. Buddy checks that each file opens from the new folder before it switches. If a file is missing or different, you stay on your old folder.
• Verifying a work sample no longer fails when the paper's file name is very long. If a path is too long for Windows, the message says so instead of saying a file was missing. Copying your records to a folder with a very long path says the same.
• While your records copy, background syncing and reading pause. The note about a pre-copy backup appears only when a backup was saved.
• Buttons you can't use right now look greyed out instead of clickable.
• When Deeper analysis finds no work that fits the rubric, it says why (for example, short answers instead of an essay) and offers Review rubric instead of running the same analysis again.
• Notes about performance recordings no longer appear on rubrics that aren't about a performance.
• Pre-grading long scanned packets now works for equivalent work and assignments with more than one option, and written work on a scanned paper is no longer reported as no work.
• Buddy's logs no longer keep students' page text or the names of missing files.
• Downloading the laptop grading model no longer stops as soon as it starts.
• The demo no longer says it can't reach its folder, and Reset demo works while the demo is open: Buddy restarts into a fresh demo.
• In the demo tour, the step about the review desk's buttons shows the whole page again, so its card has room. Your view comes back after the step.
